tx:
The following actions will give a chance to yield this item:
• Gathering divine energy from springs
• Converting memories
• Training at the Hall of Memories
• Colossi Divination
• Transmuting Senntisten crystals in the Empty Throne Room
The following actions will not give a chance to yield this pet:
• Transmuting divine energy
• Using protean memories or unstable protean memories
• Using divine simulacrums

The chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{T \times S}{50,000,000},
where:
• T is the amount of game ticks taken per action.
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million Divination experience, a flat bonus of 50 is applied to this value.
